title: Calendula officinalis essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Calendula officinalis essential oil is a concentrated extract derived from the flowers of the Calendula plant, known for its vibrant orange hue and potent therapeutic properties. It is commonly used in herbalism for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and wound-healing benefits. This oil is often applied topically to treat skin conditions such as eczema, psoriasis, and minor burns. It may also be used in aromatherapy to promote relaxation and reduce stress. Due to its strong potency, it is typically diluted before use to ensure safety and effectiveness.
